etymology.historical_story: Jarvis has a documented history as an English surname of Norman origin, connected with the personal name Gervais. Some Yorkshire families have a separate connection with the place Jervaulx. These histories concern particular surname traditions, not Malay word formation. Without a source sentence, the packet cannot establish which person, fictional character, or other named entity its token denotes. [Surname reference](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=Jarvis)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 若 Jarvis 是男性来宾的姓氏，可用 Encik Jarvis；若对方有明确的专业或学术头衔，应采用其认可的称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 作为姓名时通常写作 Jarvis。不能仅凭此拼写认定其指某个虚构助手、品牌或技术系统，也不能把某个专名直接解释成马来语的“助手”。
